step1_exhaustive_verification.description: Exhaustive, batched (verify_long_window_all_nodes) long-window verification of ALL 300 damping=0.05 configs x 24 nodes = 7200 node-checks. Resolves S-015 from a sampled estimate to an exact measurement.

step1b_exact_screening_precision_recall_.description: Exact (not sampled) cross-tabulation of the free-fix candidate mask (short window, PR-R2.6) against the TRUE (long-window) verified mask -- also checks whether PR-R2.7 Sec.19.1's 'candidates are a valid upper bound for cycle coverage' assumption held (it did not).

step1c_cycle_coverage_on_true_verified_s.description: Fundamental cycles of length>=5 fully covered by the TRUE (exhaustive, long-window) verified set -- R8's final determination per review's instruction, replacing PR-R2.7 Sec.19.1's flawed candidate-upper-bound estimate (2 cycles) with the exact count.

step1d_winding_on_all_covered_cycles.description: winding_precheck.py (still explicitly NOT R8) applied to the real instantaneous phases of all 178 TRUE-verified covered cycles, batched by unique (seed, kw) run (35 unique runs).
